customer_question: Our product uses the AX210 module -- do we need RF PHY testing for this registration, and what would the quote look like?
question_variants: Is RF PHY testing required when our product is built around AX210?
Can we reference AX210's existing registration instead of testing RF PHY ourselves?
What does the quote look like for a Multi-Design registration referencing AX210?
actual_issue: The customer's product is built around the AX210 module, and it needed to be determined whether RF PHY testing was required for the registration, or whether the module's own existing qualification could be referenced instead.
plain_english_explanation: Some Bluetooth modules are already fully qualified on their own, including the radio-level testing. When a product is built around one of these already-qualified modules, the registration can point back to that module's existing qualification (a 'Multi-Design' reference) instead of repeating the radio-level testing from scratch, which keeps the registration scope and cost down to the registration support and compliance paperwork rather than a full test campaign.
consultant_answer: Since the product uses the AX210 module, RF PHY testing is not required. The quote for this registration is for agency registration support referencing the module as a Multi-Design (¥250,000) plus compliance folder preparation (¥150,000), rather than RF/RF PHY test fees.
decision_logic: When a product is built around an already-qualified module, referencing that module's existing registration as a Multi-Design can avoid the need for new RF PHY testing, since the module's own registration already carries that evidence; the appropriate quote in this scenario covers agency registration support and compliance folder preparation rather than test fees.
final_recommendation: Before quoting RF/RF PHY testing for a product, check whether it is built around an already-qualified module whose existing registration can instead be referenced as a Multi-Design, which would change the quote to registration support and compliance folder preparation only.
risk_if_done_wrong: Quoting and performing unnecessary RF PHY testing for a product built around an already-qualified module would add avoidable cost and time when a Multi-Design reference to the module's existing registration would have sufficed.
